title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Cranberry Pomegranate & Cherry 100ml Shortfill
description: Ohm Brew Double Brew Cranberry Pomegranate and Cherry is a complex, tart, and sweet red fruit medley. The slightly dry tang of Pomegranate and Cranberry is beautifully balanced by the dark, juicy richness of Cherry, resulting in a bold and sophisticated vape. Unlike traditional high-VG shortfill e-liquids, this blend features a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio. This highly versatile formulation means it performs flawlessly in Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and pen-style devices, as well as Sub-Ohm setups at lower wattages (16-22W). The Double Brew range is richly formulated with nearly twice the standard flavour concentrate, ensuring an incredibly intense and vivid taste regardless of your chosen device. Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of 0mg nicotine e-liquid, there is space to add two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Crafted in Belfast, UK, Ohm Brew guarantees premium quality and highly authentic flavour profiles that run the gamut from timeless classics to innovative new flavours found nowhere else.
